name: Adashino Sakuya
source:
"If you're ever in a bind, don't hesitate to reach out to me."

The classmate to both Himeka and Souma, as well as the class representative. 
Sakuya is known for being reliably diligent and socially adept, winning trust and respect from both her peers and instructors in a way different from Himeka.

She has been acquainted with Himeka since before their enrollment and is one of the few people that Himeka can genuinely call a friend.

For Souma, who's new to the school, Sakuya proves to be quite accommodating. She goes out of her way to help him settle in, offering various forms of assistance and guidance.

Despite her youthful appearance, Sakuya often displays a more mature demeanor, which adds an intriguing quality to her character. This unique blend of attributes has quietly garnered her a fair share of admirers.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/sen_nagi/chara07.html]official website[/url]]
